raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The embedded Rust server's `/health_generate` is status-only: a healthy probe answers a bare 200. The Python server can attach extra response headers to it through its extension points, and the Rust frontend had no equivalent, so a subclass could not add any. This adds optional response headers to a healthy `/health_generate`, validated at startup, with an empty default.

## Modifications

- `ServerArgs` gains `health_generate_headers: BTreeMap<String, String>`, handed over from Python like every other field. `ServerArgs::validate` rejects an entry that is not a valid HTTP header name or value at startup, so a bad configuration fails at boot instead of being silently dropped per probe.
- A healthy (200) `/health_generate` carries the configured headers. `/health` keeps the same deep probe when `SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION` is on but does not add them; 503 responses never carry them.
- `RustServer._health_generate_headers(scheduler)` is the Python-side hook, in the same style as `_load_extension` / `_resolve_multimodal`: it returns `{}` by default, and a model package subclass overrides it. `launch` passes its result to `_build_server_args`, which has a matching `health_generate_headers` keyword.

Default behavior is unchanged: with no override the map is empty and the responses are byte-identical to before.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (no model or numerics change).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable (one header insert per healthy deep-probe response).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). `pre-commit run --files <changed files>` passes.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
  - `rust/`: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --locked -p sglang-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --locked -p sglang-server` (320 passed), including the new `healthy_probe_carries_configured_headers` (headers on a healthy `/health_generate`, none on `/health`) and `validate_requires_served_model_name_and_valid_health_headers` (a bad header name is rejected).
  - Python: `test/registered/unit/multimodal/rust/shared/test_rust_server_extension.py`, `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`, `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_parity.py`: 24 passed, 21 subtests.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No user-facing flag; the hook is documented in its docstring and the `ServerArgs` field doc.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable, see above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
 import logging
 import os
 from types import ModuleType
-from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Callable, List, Optional, Tuple
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
 
 from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolving_view
 from sglang.srt.managers.utils import compute_num_reserved_tokens
@@ -27,7 +27,10 @@
 
 
 def _build_server_args(
-    scheduler: Scheduler, *, extension: Optional[ModuleType] = None
+    scheduler: Scheduler,
+    *,
+    extension: Optional[ModuleType] = None,
+    health_generate_headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 ) -> ServerArgs:
     """The typed launch configuration for the scheduler's embedded Rust server:
     the ``server_args`` fields it reads, the already-resolved
@@ -74,6 +77,7 @@ def _build_server_args(
         detokenizer_worker_num=get_serving().detokenizer_worker_num,
         skip_tokenizer_init=get_serving().skip_tokenizer_init,
         skip_server_warmup=get_serving().skip_server_warmup,
+        health_generate_headers=dict(health_generate_headers or {}),
         incremental_streaming_output=get_serving().incremental_streaming_output,
         disaggregation_mode=disaggregation_mode,
         model_config=ext.ModelConfig(

@@ -68,6 +68,12 @@ def __init__(
         self._multimodal_enabled = mm_spec is not None
         self._max_per_poll = max_per_poll
 
+    @classmethod
+    def _health_generate_headers(cls, scheduler: Scheduler) -> Dict[str, str]:
+        """Headers a healthy ``/health_generate`` carries; a deployment's
+        router may read its metadata off the deep health probe."""
+        return {}
+
     @classmethod
     def _load_extension(cls) -> ModuleType:
         from sglang.srt.rust_extensions import load_rust_extension
@@ -167,7 +173,11 @@ def launch(cls, scheduler: Scheduler) -> RustServer:
 
         extension = cls._load_extension()
         server = extension.Server(
-            _build_server_args(scheduler, extension=extension),
+            _build_server_args(
+                scheduler,
+                extension=extension,
+                health_generate_headers=cls._health_generate_headers(scheduler),
+            ),
             # None runs unpinned; otherwise the list carries the pinning decision.
             cores=server_cores,
             port_offset=local_dp_rank,

@@ -81,7 +81,9 @@ def _start_multimodal(self, scheduler):
         with launch_context(ModelServer) as build_args:
             instance = ModelServer.launch(scheduler)
 
-        build_args.assert_called_once_with(scheduler, extension=extension)
+        build_args.assert_called_once_with(
+            scheduler, extension=extension, health_generate_headers={}
+        )
         extension.Server.assert_called_once_with(
             sentinel.args, cores=None, port_offset=1
         )
